stem: Four scouting rounds used the same route and sample size. Average symptom severity remains low, but the number of affected plants doubles each round and new zones are involved. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: The issue is stable because severity is low
The expanding incidence and spatial spread indicate increasing pressure even though individual severity remains low
The scouting data should be ignored until severity becomes high
The affected plants should be moved through clean production to confirm the pattern
rationale: Repeated comparable sampling shows expansion through incidence and spatial spread. Low severity on individual plants does not make an expanding problem stable.
